Seed reproduction and vegetative cloning; avoid unqualified two-separate-parent requirement.
Seed water uptake and stored reserves; germination and subsequent growth distinguished.
Light requirements for germination are species-specific; not all seeds require light.

Ordinary classroom rusting of iron requires oxygen and water; salt speeds up rusting.
Insulin/glucagon regulation of blood glucose; use a schematic with no clinical values or dose decisions.
Pancreas makes insulin; insulin helps glucose enter cells; type1 and type2 mechanisms distinct. Population statistics were not selected for these lessons.

Inhalation diaphragm contraction, greater thoracic volume and lower pressure; quiet exhalation relaxation. For school use, distinguish ventilation from cellular respiration even if a medical source uses respiration more broadly.
Species richness and relative abundance describe different properties of a community.
Biodiversity has multiple dimensions; avoid equating richness alone to every biodiversity measure.
